objective.required_end_state: Regenerate the original 390 crust-core EOS combinations using one native Fortran calculation backend, preserving source provenance and the supported CompOSE composition semantics. Python is an invocation/serialization/reporting frontend only. The historical Python implementation is read-only legacy/reference code.

architecture.single_physics_ssot: fortran_eos and integrated native stellar solver modules

equations: Q6 = Q7 at T=0 within the source contract

sharp_maxwell.charge_assumption: local electric charge neutrality in each coexisting phase; not a Gibbs/global-neutrality construction
output_invariants: P is continuous at the interface
mu_B is continuous at the interface
n_B and epsilon have a positive finite jump
no continuous-density plateau is labelled first-order Maxwell
sharp_maxwell.multiple_root_policy: Do not choose a root by arbitrary order. Restrict to the native branch-selection window; require the prescribed unique admissible coexistence root or return AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_ROOTS.
sharp_maxwell.seidov: Record the Seidov rapid-onset diagnostic separately; it is not a proof of a complete stable TOV branch.

physical_contract.legacy_maxwell_policy: The historical Python and native smooth-pressure-plateau implementation is scientifically mislabelled because Delta n_B=0. It is read-only legacy and the native match_crust_core alias is temporarily fail-closed. The final method token maxwell must invoke the sharp construction.

compose_contract.supported_scope: Cold T=0, one-dimensional fixed-(iT,iYq) CompOSE slice; particle IDs {0,1,10,11}; at most one nuclear-group quadruple with group ID 1; Nadd 0 or 1. Unsupported general CompOSE dimensions/species/layouts must fail explicitly, not be silently flattened.

composition.serialization: Y_I = Y_h/Abar when Abar>0; otherwise no nuclear-group quadruple
composition.phase_metadata: Iphase is an integer categorical label whose physical meaning is model/provider-specific. Never interpret a numeric ID as a universal phase name.
composition.phase_only_rows: When no abundance values exist but Iphase metadata must be retained, CompOSE v3.01 permits Npairs=0 and Nquad=0. Keep composition_file_present separate from composition_available.
composition.output_mapping: When two provider tables are combined, remap source-local Iphase labels deterministically and write the complete (provider,source_Iphase)->output_Iphase mapping and human-readable phase legend into provenance metadata.
composition.no_fabrication: Never fabricate particle fractions, Abar, Zbar, or Y_I when source composition is absent. For APR_APR and BBB_BHF2, only create model-derived beta-equilibrium composition through the explicitly ported and provenance-labelled legacy literature solver.

nadd.policy: Preserve Nadd/q_extra on untouched rows whenever the same declared meaning is valid across the combined output. If provider-specific Nadd meanings cannot be unified, either retain an explicit source sidecar or drop only under a named DROP_WITH_RECEIPT policy; never silently relabel or interpolate categorical flags.
nadd.source_observation: SPG_M1 was observed with Nadd=0; GPPVA_FSU2H was observed with Nadd=1 and q_extra values 0/1.

q3_convention.Il_1: Q3+1 maps to Euler baryon chemical potential divided by m_n on the supported beta-equilibrium branch with Q5 approximately zero.
q3_convention.Il_0: Recover Euler mu_B by adding Yq*mu_q to the stored Q3-derived potential: mu_Euler = (Q3+1)*m_n + Yq*Q4*m_n.
q3_convention.tolerances: Keep the source/reconstruction algebraic tolerance distinct from the sharp-Maxwell kernel Euler consistency tolerance.

baseline.source: Dropbox EOS core-crust release v3.2 dated 2026-11-06
baseline.reported_full_table_failures: APR_APR and RG_KDE0v1 high-density C10 acausality
baseline.policy: These are recorded historical v3.2 results, not new independent execution evidence. Preserve source EOS tables unchanged. Never clip or relabel an acausal tail as a repaired microscopic EOS.

Original v3.2 outputs and source folders are read-only
All 18 model readmes and datasheets are indexed

gates.name: Legacy behavior characterization
acceptance: All six method IDs are characterized
Historical maxwell plateau is documented as Delta n_B=0 and not first-order
Composition, Nadd, Q3/Il, phase and TOV/tidal behaviors are recorded

gates.name: CompOSE native I/O and composition
acceptance: Fortran reader/writer round-trip raw Q1..Q7, Iphase, species fractions, Abar/Zbar/Y_I and supported Nadd
Phase-only eos.compo round-trips Iphase with Npairs=0,Nquad=0
Baryon and charge abundance closure are tested
Unsupported formats are explicit errors

gates.name: Native literature composition solvers
acceptance: APR and BHF2 beta-equilibrium solvers ported from legacy symmetry-energy model with provenance
Provider-table composition preserved for supported core models
Lepton threshold and electron/muon split verified

gates.name: Five smooth matching methods in Fortran
acceptance: css,cubic_F,cubic_P,quintic_F,quintic_P ported with composition handling
Source rows outside the selected gap are byte/value preserved where contractually possible
Bridge composition uses the characterized legacy smootherstep policy or an explicitly approved superior physical policy

gates.name: Sharp Maxwell in common native matching API
acceptance: method=maxwell produces nonzero density and energy jumps
Unique coexistence root with equal P and mu_B
Low/high composition is preserved without interpolating across the jump
Provider-local Iphase and Nadd semantics are handled
Delta epsilon=mu_t*Delta n_B is checked

gates.name: Native TOV, tidal and Cowling integration
acceptance: Smooth EOS paths use Fortran TOV/tidal solver
Sharp Maxwell path uses phase-segmented Fortran TOV and interface-aware Cowling
No Python/SciPy numerical integration is used in production
Slow/rapid conversion interface conditions are tested

gates.name: Fortran-owned 390 batch runner
acceptance: Fortran consumes one exact pair/method manifest
Exactly 390 unique tasks are scheduled
Each task writes an isolated output folder and machine receipt
Failures remain failures/diagnostic-only; no silent skipping

gates.name: Differential, physical and numerical validation
acceptance: Native results are compared with immutable v3.2 outputs and legacy references only as validation oracles
Analytic Maxwell fixtures recover known coexistence exactly
Root topology, phase-edge, composition and Nadd cases are covered
C1-C11, interpolation interval extrema, TOV/tidal and convergence evidence are preserved

gates.name: New versioned 390 regeneration and handoff
acceptance: All 390 pair-method statuses exist
All generated CompOSE tables read back
New output manifest and SHA-256 are complete
Historical 390 outputs remain unchanged
Dropbox progress snapshot and local execution receipt are saved

nodes.title: Regenerate into new versioned folder and publish progress

allowed: new docs/data artifacts in this branch

perform Python/SciPy EOS/TOV/Cowling calculations in production
mutation_policy.commits: Use exact branch HEAD as parent and expected-SHA update. Never force-push or mutate main.
mutation_policy.output_versioning: Each regeneration gets a fresh versioned folder; retries write a new attempt ID, not over existing output.

local_agent.goal: Complete M0-M9, execute the native Fortran build and all 390 source-backed regeneration tasks, and produce an auditable new output set without modifying the frozen legacy inputs.
first_actions: record git HEAD and dirty state
run baseline build/tests before changing more code
